notes.title: Additions, Fixes & Changes!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello there, fellow Tiny Terrace enjoyers! 🌿🌱🌞 
[/p][p]Here's an update of what was changed/added (also sorry this took a bit, there were a few patches I had to do following the mobile release to fix different issues):[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45127895/4cc3577496371fb6fe43cef225ce8b367b07dbd0.png"][/img][/p][h3](as of v0.90.715.7876)[/h3][h3] 🔨Here are some things that I have added/fixed/changed.[/h3][list][*][p]Added the ability to make Jam & Jelly out of Berries and Melons. \[picture above] 🍓[/p][/*][*][p]Added Search bar to Inventory & Shop[/p][/*][*][p]Changed Auto-Seeder to be able to be upgraded, so you can now purchase tiles for it to target.  Each of them starts with 4 tiles(in the plus formation as before), which you can now edit auto-seeders to target any tiles as long as they are connected by an adjacent selected tile or the building itself.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed "STORAGE IS EMPTY" and other text in inventory not being translated to other languages[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted save stuff to make it a little safer[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the middle Seed/Building selection UI from staying open above Bottom Menus when opened[/p][/*][*][p]Added name popups when hovering over Unlocked stuff in the Progress Unlock Popup.[/p][/*][*][p]Stopped allowing camera movement while the Progress Unlock Popup is active.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed upside-down fish[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some Scrollbar issues[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized several things[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted how building move works, so you can now just drag buildings to where you want without having to click the building, then the move selector, and an additional click of where it should be placed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed errors when picking up a fella that is trying to / currently sitting[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted some Tutorials[/p][/*][*][p]Added a notification bell button in the bottom left corner, which can be used to disable the normal item notifications. (It will still show the error pop-up type notifications)[/p][/*][*][p]Increased size of the building destruction selected building button UI.[/p][/*][*][p]Stopped fellas from flipping to the wrong direction when poked.[/p][/*][*][p]Stopped the text pop-up from happening when selecting a seed through the Storage tab while overlapping the selected seed/building middle UI[/p][/*][*][p]Increased size of the fella upgrade menu[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed flip/flopping overlaps of buildings when producing next to each other[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized butterflies a little.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed text in transition between menu and farm from extending outside the screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Even more optimizations[/p][/*][*][p]Added Auto-Seeder tutorial[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed one building missing a price[/p][/*][*][p]Mobile Specific Changes Below(in case you own that version)[/p][list][*][p]Fixed the Building destruction selection area being dragged while zooming[/p][/*][*][p]Two-finger camera moving added for while tools or certain things that require dragging are active.[/p][/*][*][p]Bottom Bar moved up a little[/p][/*][*][p]Building Destruction UI size increased[/p][/*][*][p]The game now overrides the phone's default Sleep mode when open.[/p][/*][*][p]Added mobile-specific variations of tutorials[/p][/*][*][p]A double 3-finger tap to hide UI and a single 3-finger tap to unhide UI.[/p][/*][*][p]Offset destruction/build mode top text if under an island/camera that blocks it.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjust sickle tool for plant marking.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b](?)[/b] = possible fix[/p][p][/p][h3]📃Known Issues:[/h3][list][*][p]The progress goal popup has some visual issues and errors[/p][/*][*][p]Hat UI is broken, and if a hat is equipped it doesn't load back in[/p][/*][*][p]Loading back in sometimes malfunctions, causing a clearing of some amount of your farm. (possibly fixed)[/p][/*][*][p]Autoseeder gets stuck, sometimes doesn't detect empty plantable tiles next to it, and sometimes also repeatedly tries to plant the same already planted tile.[/p][/*][*][p]Strange visuals with the fellas after a while of playing.[/p][/*][*][p]Clicking outside the window then back in with the middle mouse shifts the camera randomly[/p][/*][*][p][b](?) [/b]Performance degrades over time \[Probably because of memory leaks(but currently unsure)][/p][/*][*][p]Crashes sometimes \[Also probably because of memory leaks(but currently unsure)][/p][/*][*][p]Various visual issues[/p][/*][*][p]Some egg delivery fellas stand in a place making the eggs ungrabbable[/p][/*][*][p]Cooking Pot uses wrong sounds[/p][/*][*][p]Auto-Seeder drones can be invisible while still placing seeds.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]I will continue to patch up the game. Thanks for checking out the game! :D

I'll should start adding new content soon, while continuing to fix stuff, so stay tuned.[/p][h2]

[b]Try out the game if you haven't :)[/b][/h2][h3]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3136330?utm_source=pchnt"][/dynamiclink]There is also a mobile version. 📱[/h3][h3]If you want to check it out, here's the link: 
iOS: [url="https://apps.apple.com/us/app/tiny-terraces/id6633412890"]Tiny Terraces on iOS[/url]   Android: [url="https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.VuVuu.TinyTerraces"]Tiny Terraces on Android[/url] 
[/h3][p]*Note that these updates are delayed for mobile by a day or two, because they must get approval from Apple & Google before going live.[/p]

notes.title: More Fixes/Changes
notes.notes:
[p]Hello there, fellow Tiny Terrace enjoyers! 🌿🌱🌞 
[/p][p]The game was released recently, thank you for all the suggestions/error reports, here are some things that I have fixed in this most recent patch.  [/p][p][/p][p](as of v0.90.637.7176)[/p][p] 🔨Here are some things that I have fixed/changed.[/p][list][*][p]Fixed money exploit.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some dropped items never being able to be picked up again.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing translations[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the info tab of the journal not being scrollable[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed compost heap, disable all compost heap UIs(including itself) when clicked on, if there is more than 1 in the farm[/p][/*][*][p]Lowered sound of the Autoseeder[/p][/*][*][p]Added keys for the journal button, animal info button, axe tool, and sickle tool[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed items required for a progress goal to be completed, not having names, causing confusion of what they are.[/p][/*][*][p]Moved some text popups to avoid blocking information[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the beehive upgrade button not appearing after loading a beehive[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed beehives producing honey, they don't even have pollen to produce.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed beehives not using some hive frames to produce honey[/p][/*][*][p]Moved building harvest task to higher priority(collecting from Hives, Juice Barrels, Cooking Pots, and Tree Taps)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed fruit trees no longer being harvestable if a tree tap is placed on them.[/p][/*][*][p]Moved the layer visibility button with progress goal when opened.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed visual issue with tree taps[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed beehive honey popup blocking part of beehive ui when open[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Autoseeder drone sound not being audibly scaled when offscreen[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Fella talking noises not being audibly scaled when offscreen[/p][/*][*][p]Lowered density of fog weather[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Fellas menu cutting off the bottom-most fella in the list[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed loaded ponds not being destructible.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Fellas not going to the nearest storage upon picking up items to deliver[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed opening cooking pot ui, not closing other cooking pot ui's that are open.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Animal Info menu not scrolling far enough, and first animal being slightly cutoff on the top.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]📃Known Issues:[/p][list][*][p]The progress goal popup has some visual issues and errors[/p][/*][*][p]Fellas standing around doing nothing[/p][/*][*][p]Hat UI is broken, and if a hat is equipped it doesn't load back in[/p][/*][*][p]Loading back in sometimes malfunctions, causing a clearing of some amount of your farm. (possibly fixed)[/p][/*][*][p]Juice Barrel and Cooking Pot are behaving strangely, causing the wrong item production[/p][/*][*][p]Autoseeder gets stuck, sometimes doesn't detect empty plantable tiles next to it, and sometimes also repeatedly tries to plant the same already planted tile.[/p][/*][*][p]Autoseeder doesn't load previously selected seed.[/p][/*][*][p]Strange visuals with the fellas after a while of playing.[/p][/*][*][p]Clicking outside the window then back in with the middle mouse shifts the camera randomly[/p][/*][*][p]Performance degrades over time \[Probably because of memory leaks(but currently unsure)][/p][/*][*][p]Crashes sometimes \[Also probably because of memory leaks(but currently unsure)][/p][/*][*][p]Various visual issues[/p][/*][*][p]Placed fertilizer remains on tile even after destruction[/p][/*][*][p]Some egg delivery fellas stand in a place making the eggs ungrabbable[/p][/*][*][p]Destroying pond tile gives wrong gold amount.[/p][/*][*][p]Swapping to Fullscreen can cause main UI bar to dissappear off screen[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Note for the save files getting messed up sometimes:
I think it was to do with saves being started and the game only finished part of it before the game then quit(from the few people I had asked, they were playing on Linux, so potentially proton was changing the way my code for waiting for the save to finish before fully closing the game was being messed with).

I believe I should have it fixed, but if you are playing the game currently, the safest way to make sure the save finishes is by returning to the main menu before quitting the game.  [/p][p][/p][p]And if it does happen to be a loading issue, I've added some stuff so that one failed tile(whether it be a building or some other data that belongs to that tile) shouldn't mess up the rest of the farm loading.[/p][p][/p][p]I'll be working on a better loading system soon, to hopefully allow for better recovery of data if it gets messed up.
[/p][p]I will continue to patch up the game. Thanks for checking out the game! :D[/p]

notes.title: Release Update?
notes.notes:
[p]Hello there, fellow Tiny Terrace enjoyers! 🌿🌱🌞 [/p][p][/p][p]I've decided to swap the Tiny Terraces full release to an Early Access release. This doesn't mean I'm releasing with any less content, I'm just reclassifying what I consider to be v1.0. The release dates remain the same: July 31st for Steam, August 8th for Mobile(iOS & Android). The game will be released as version 0.9, and I plan to keep it in Early Access for approximately a few months before doing the v1.0 release. 


I know this will make some people sad/mad, sorry about that. But I will continue to develop/update the game, adding even more content to the game as was already intended. I will continue posting videos/shorts to the [url="https://www.youtube.com/c/VuVuuInc"]VuVuu Inc. YouTube channel[/url] throughout the Early Access period (I'll try to target posting some sort of video every few days), so that you can see what's being worked on.

[/p][p]Also, recently, I showed off on the channel that I added a couple of buildings, the [b]Juice Barrel[/b] and [b]Cooking Pot[/b]. 

As the name suggests, the Juice Barrel makes [b]juice which is worth 2x the base product's price[/b]. Currently, it allows processing of all fruits, berries, melons, Coffee beans, Tea leaves, and some vegetables.  [/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45127895/9842e50e4be2f127b2b3be757a7c251dc40f658d.png"][/img]
[/p][p]And the Cooking Pot currently can process Fruits into [b]Jam worth 2.5x the base product's price[/b], and Fruit Juices into [b]Jelly worth 2x the Juice price[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45127895/99901bf08c0f800bcc12779d6735a4a1b29e843b.png"][/img]
[/p][p][b]Thanks for sticking around, and sorry if this announcement disappoints you.[/b][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Try the demo if you haven't already! :D[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3289470/Tiny_Terraces/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Release Date?
notes.notes:
[p]Hello there, fellow Tiny Terrace enjoyers! 🌿🌱🌞 [/p][p][/p][p]I wanted to give an update on the release date. [b]I'm targeting July 31st[/b] (I assume I will be capable of hitting that date) [b]for the release of Tiny Terraces v1.0[/b] [/p][p]v1.0 won't be the end of the game, there will be at least a few decent-sized content updates that follow, but yeah, the release should happen in about 2 weeks :D[/p][p][/p][p]
📃 To the people who use macOS, 
I am trying to get it functional for launch. There is a single issue with the window placement stuff that needs to be fixed, which I haven't been able to solve. [/p][p]The rest of the game functions perfectly fine, but I cannot remove the ability to have it on the bottom/side of the screen, as it is one of the main features, even though it can still be played in full screen, as many players have done. I attempted to fix it several times, wasting many hours, but it continues to persist.  [/p][p]So I will try to get it on there 🤞, but I can't guarantee it, as I've responded to many people who have asked throughout its development.

[/p][p][b]Thanks for sticking around![/b][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Try the demo if you haven't already! :D[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3289470/Tiny_Terraces/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: v0.23.503.4934 Demo Update
notes.notes:

 - Redid the middle mouse panning to move the correct amount.
 - Improved the wind visuals.
 - Optimized game a little more.
 - Adjusted translations for Brazilian Portuguese
 - Changed plant shaking
 - Fixed a few Errors

 - Adjusted window placement stuff to not overlay taskbar (should work with taskbar being on bottom, top, left, and right, but I don't have activated windows so I can't test anything other than the bottom placement).

Thank you for playing the game :)

notes.title: v0.22.482.4556 Demo Update
